description: PAID ($0.05). Compliance verdict: is a salary at, above or below the country's statutory minimum wage? Returns verdict, margin, the statutory floor and the legal instrument it rests on. Honest statuses when no enforceable floor exists or the period doesn't match the floor's period (cross-period conversion is never guessed). Pass api_key if you have one (instant card checkout at /pricing); otherwise the response explains how to pay via x402. The evaluation country is free to try (see list_series). Optional receipt (boolean, default false): on a paid success, include an Ed25519 answer receipt at no extra USDC. An answer receipt is not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} is $0.25 and is not an MCP tool) and is not legal advice. Verify with verify_answer_receipt against /certified/public-key.

amount.description: Wage to check, in the country's own currency

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

period.description: Period the amount covers — must match the statutory floor's period

receipt.description: Default false. When true, a paid success includes an Ed25519 answer receipt (kind answer_receipt) at no extra USDC. Unpaid 402 and free refusals do not include one. Not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} at $0.25; that SKU is not an MCP tool).

name: check_minimum_wage

confidence_label.description: Evidence verdict derived from source type, verification age and the stale flag (answers: the weakest series read). Rules at /label-rules

coverage_label.description: How much of the question is covered: ready = complete; partial = held with a disclosed limitation or default; gap = no number served. Rules at /label-rules

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

label_basis.description: Inputs and the rule ids that produced the two labels

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card

provenance.description: Cited official sources behind the answer

receipt.description: Ed25519 answer receipt when receipt=true on a paid success

status.description: Answer status, e.g. computed or an honest no-answer status
